title: skribbl - Free Multiplayer Drawing & Guessing Game
summary: Multiplayer pictionary-style game: players take turns drawing a word while others guess in real time, in public or private rooms of up to 20 people.
why: Real-time drawing and guessing with friends or strangers; custom words, many languages, and room settings make it easy to set up a quick round.
